title: Giant skeletons dug up in excavations of monumental earthworks

tellings.quote: The excavations particularly associated with the monumental earthworks giant skeletons. Those accounts are repeated over and over and over again that in the excavation there's a giant skeleton dug up sometimes seven feet sometimes eight sometimes even nine feet in height.

plain: Old accounts of digs at America's great earthen mounds tell again and again of giant human skeletons, "sometimes seven feet sometimes eight sometimes even nine feet in height," according to the researcher Randall Carlson. He summarises this for Michels from records he points to, such as 19th-century archives at Emory's library, Bureau of American Ethnology records and early Smithsonian papers, without quoting any one of them. If true, a race of very tall people would once have lived in North America.
